name: Signal Function Set
_comment: Build script will modify slug/name/version for dev builds to allow coexistence
author: Stuart Frederich-Smith

modules.name: Drift
modules.description: Phase shifted LFO with offset, attenuation and stability controls

modules.name: GSX
modules.description: Granular synthesis after Barry Truax's GSX system (1985-86).

modules.name: Fugue
modules.description: 8-step harmonic deviation sequencer with three independent CV/gate voices

modules.name: Phase
modules.description: Dual sample looper whose two loops gradually drift apart, with transient detection.

modules.name: Overtone
modules.description: Additive VCO with eight togglable harmonics, even/odd filter and binary-mask CV.

modules.name: Intone
modules.description: CHANT/FOF formant voice with vowel morphing across five formant cells.

modules.name: Tine
modules.description: Tunable pingable resonator after the Gamelan Resonator circuit.

modules.name: Fugue X
modules.description: Expander for Fugue: per-voice steps, range, sleep and probability.

modules.name: MetaFugue
modules.description: Fugue and Fugue X on one panel, for hosts without expander support.

modules.name: Meter
modules.description: Time-signature-aware musical clock with per-output swing and external sync.

modules.name: Meter X
modules.description: Expander for Meter: 24 PPQN clock, Run gate, and 1 to 128-bar triggers.

modules.name: Beat
modules.description: Per-voice drum sequencer, 8 patterns x 16 steps with velocity and accent.

modules.name: Note
modules.description: Monophonic CV/gate sequencer with a 12-note pitch matrix and scale selection.

modules.name: Swell
modules.description: Ping-driven additive envelope: each ping stacks a rise over a shared decay.

modules.name: Shift
modules.description: Four-lane CV shift register with per-lane delay and cascade modes.

modules.name: Wave
modules.description: Parametric wavetable voice: six macros shape it, eight snapshots form the table.

modules.name: Vac
modules.description: Semi-stable A/R envelope with vactrol-like drift that wanders without collapsing.

modules.name: Muse
modules.description: Faithful Triadex Muse recreation, with four theme and four interval sliders.

modules.name: Gravity
modules.description: Chaos engine with six visual modes, from double pendulum to LOGO turtle.

modules.name: Band
modules.description: Harmonic bandpass bank: four bands lock to integer harmonics of one fundamental.

modules.name: Cycle
modules.description: Bar-synced quad LFO with morphable shapes, or free-running when unpatched.

modules.name: Operator
modules.description: DX7-style six-operator FM voice. Loads .syx cartridges and plays polyphonically.

modules.name: OP ENV
modules.description: Standalone DX7 operator envelope, loaded from a .syx bank and fired by a gate.

modules.name: Chance
modules.description: Generative melodic walk: a seeded core melody that may stray to a neighbour.

modules.name: Record
modules.description: Auto-sampler: drives a voice across notes and velocities, then writes WAVs + .sfz.

modules.name: Play
modules.description: Polyphonic multisample player for SFZ and DecentSampler instruments.

modules.name: Ratio
modules.description: Quad ratio VCA: one signal and one CV to four outs, each with its own ratio.

modules.name: Arrange
modules.description: Song-form sequencer: a chain of 8 phrases, each with its own length, key and tempo.

modules.name: Fill
modules.description: Auto-playing drum sequencer whose pressure builds each bar and vents as a fill.

modules.name: Chime
modules.description: Eight-note drone machine: each note blooms as its resonator tube passes centre.

modules.name: Crystal
modules.description: A 3D echo chamber shaped like a real crystal habit, with four listeners as quad outs.

modules.name: Loom
modules.description: Eight-string resonator sharing one bridge, so a struck string rings its neighbours.

modules.name: Key
modules.description: Quantizer that takes its key from the patch, so one key change reaches every module.

modules.name: Slide
modules.description: Electric lap steel: eight strings stopped by a steel bar, with slant and rate glide.

modules.name: OP MORPH
modules.description: Expander for Operator: the DX7 routing as a matrix you navigate as a wrapping field.

modules.name: SLIDE XP
modules.description: Expander for Slide: the eight strings on eight jacks, gate and velocity each.

modules.name: Slice
modules.description: Cuts a stereo stream onto a grid and reworks each piece: cut, reverse, stutter, pitch.

modules.name: Kit
modules.description: Struck membrane modelled mode by mode: tom, timpani, gong or snare.
